description: Olympic champion, men's sprinting (track and field), active.

facts.fact: Won the 100m gold medal at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
Olympic 200m bronze at Tokyo 2020 (and again in 2024).
Turned professional with Adidas in July 2016 instead of running for Florida.
Sprint triple (100m, 200m, 4x100m) at the 2023 World Championships.
